build_causal_lm_model: build a LagunaForCausalLM model from a config for causal language modeling with mixture of experts
generate_text_with_laguna: generate text using a LagunaForCausalLM model with generation mixin and past key values cache
create_moe_base_model: create a LagunaModel base model that returns MoE outputs with past key values
compute_load_balancing_loss: compute the auxiliary load balancing loss for MoE expert routing using load_balancing_loss_func
apply_rotary_position_embedding: apply rotary position embeddings to query and key tensors using apply_rotary_pos_emb
